title: MNBL source identity
description: Identity of one FWGC++ split world that the campaign compiler carries forward. Written by worldbridge::source::write_identity (worldbridge --read-source --identity FILE) and validated strictly by read_identity. The 64-bit layout seed is a canonical decimal string: as a JSON number it would lose precision above 2^53.

generatorVersion.description: Descriptive only; not a build fingerprint.

layoutSeed.description: Unsigned 64-bit decimal, at most 18446744073709551615 (checked by read_identity).
